oil.when: 2000–2001, using the STATUS and RESET message center controls
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed.
Press STATUS to open the System Check, which includes the oil life reading.
Press and hold RESET until the message center shows OIL LIFE SET TO 100%.
oil.note: Pressing RESET and SETUP together from the System Check opens a service mode for setting a lower starting percentage, for owners who want shorter intervals.
